 Surabaya Weather Today, November 11, 2026: BMKG Predicts Afternoon Rain and Temperatures up to 35 Degrees
 Surabaya weather forecast for November 11, 2026, by BMKG. The day will be cloudy and hot with temperatures reaching 35 degrees Celsius, with a potential for light rain in the afternoon.
 By: Fadhila Nuraini 
 | 
 Editor: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Contributor: Adit Pranata 
 November 11, 2026, 11:31 WITA · 5 min read 
 Photo caption: Illustration of street conditions in Surabaya with cloudy skies and wet road surfaces after rain. BMKG forecasts that the weather in Surabaya today, Wednesday (11/11/2026), has the potential for rain from the afternoon into the evening. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 SURABAYA, Aktualita.co -  Residents of Surabaya planning outdoor activities on Wednesday (11/11/2026) should pay attention to changing weather conditions. The sky over the City of Heroes is expected to be dominated by clouds from morning until afternoon, while light rain has the potential to fall in several areas toward the evening. 
 Based on the forecast from the Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG), air temperatures in Surabaya today will range between 25 and 35 degrees Celsius, depending on the location. These conditions mean the air may feel hot during the day even if the sky is not completely clear. 
 Advertisement 
 The potential for rain is a concern, especially for people active until the afternoon , including workers, students, traders, and two-wheeled vehicle users. 
 However, the rain forecast does not mean that the entire Surabaya area will be hit by rain simultaneously. Atmospheric conditions can differ between the city center, residential areas, and coastal regions. 
 Surabaya Weather Forecast from Morning to Night 
 The BMKG weather forecast shows changes in air conditions throughout Wednesday, November 11, 2026. 
 In the morning, the sky over Surabaya is generally expected to be cloudy. Air temperatures will begin to rise after sunrise, from the 25–28 degrees Celsius range toward around 30 degrees Celsius by midday. 
 Entering 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM WIB, temperatures in several areas are expected to rise to 33–35 degrees Celsius. 
 Cloudy weather during this period does not always make the air feel cool. Heat exposure and humidity levels can still cause a feeling of sultriness, especially in areas with dense vehicle activity and buildings. 
 Weather changes are expected to be more noticeable in the afternoon. Several forecast points indicate the potential for light rain, especially around 5:00 PM WIB. 
 The rain is expected to be local in nature, so not all districts will experience the same conditions. 
 Entering the evening, the weather in several areas has the chance to return to cloudy or partly cloudy. Air temperatures are expected to drop to the 26–29 degrees Celsius range. 
 The public is still advised to pay attention to the latest forecast developments because the timing and location of rainfall can change. 
 Surabaya Weather by Region 
 BMKG provides weather forecasts down to the district and sub-district level so that the public can check conditions according to their respective locations. 
 In Karang Pilang District, the forecast shows the potential for light rain with temperatures ranging from 26–34 degrees Celsius. Air humidity is also relatively high, especially in the morning and evening. 
 The Wonocolo area is expected to experience temperatures of around 26–34 degrees Celsius with a possibility of light rain during some periods. 
 Meanwhile, Rungkut has a temperature range of around 27–34 degrees Celsius. People in this area need to pay attention to weather changes toward the afternoon. 
 The Wonokromo and Tegalsari areas are also among those with the potential for light rain in the BMKG daily forecast. 
 As for Genteng, which is one of the central activity areas in Surabaya, it is expected to experience temperatures up to 35 degrees Celsius. 
 These differences in conditions show the importance of looking at forecasts based on the district, rather than just using one weather report for the entire city. 
 Hot Temperatures During the Day Still Need to be Watched 
 In addition to rain, air temperature is a factor that Surabaya residents need to pay attention to today. 
 The maximum temperature forecast reaches 35 degrees Celsius in several areas. This condition can feel more uncomfortable when air humidity is high and air circulation is limited. 
 For those working outdoors, such as online motorcycle taxi drivers, field officers, construction workers, and traders, prolonged heat exposure needs to be anticipated. 
 Meeting fluid needs, using head protection, and seeking shade when necessary are simple steps to reduce the risks from heat exposure. 
 Motorcyclists also need to consider weather changes that can occur in a relatively short time. 
 Hot weather during the day does not rule out the possibility of rain a few hours later. Therefore, carrying a raincoat remains a sensible choice even if the journey begins when the sky looks clear. 
 Weather Conditions Around Juanda Airport 
 Atmospheric conditions in the area around Surabaya are also a concern, especially for transportation activities. 
 BMKG aviation weather data at Juanda International Airport on Wednesday morning showed hazy air conditions around 5:30 AM WIB. 
 During that period, the temperature was recorded at around 26 degrees Celsius with visibility of about four kilometers. 
 The subsequent forecast shows conditions gradually becoming partly cloudy, with visibility expected to improve. 
 However, weather information at Juanda Airport is data for the airport area and cannot be directly assumed to represent the entire Surabaya City area. 
 Airline passengers still need to follow official operational information from airlines and airport management if weather conditions change. 
 What is the Weather in Surabaya Tomorrow? 
 For Thursday, November 12, 2026, the BMKG forecast shows that the weather in many areas of Surabaya will still be dominated by cloudy conditions. 
 Air temperatures are expected to range from 25–34 degrees Celsius in several areas, including Karang Pilang and Wonocolo. 
 These conditions indicate that hot air during the day still has the potential to continue, although the intensity of cloud formation can change throughout the day. 
 This forecast may be updated following the development of atmospheric conditions. 
 Residents Asked to Monitor Latest Weather Information 
 Changes in weather from hot to rainy need to be a concern for residents, especially those traveling in the afternoon to evening. 
 Drivers should reduce speed if rain makes road surfaces slippery. Meanwhile, people active in open spaces need to seek shelter if lightning or strong winds occur. 
 Residents can also pay attention to the condition of water channels around their homes to anticipate puddles when it rains. 
 BMKG provides weather forecast information based on location as well as early warning updates if potential dangerous weather is detected. 
 By considering this forecast, the weather in Surabaya today , Wednesday, November 11, 2026, is expected to be cloudy and hot during the day, accompanied by the potential for light rain in several areas in the afternoon. 
 People who have outdoor agendas should prepare equipment to face the rain while also anticipating hot temperatures.
